type: 必要功能验证；不是数值压测记录或完整性能验收
business_steps: Aeron claims an empty existing-input wrapper, publishes via original SPSC input queue, then Owner hands its command to the existing FIFO before clearing/returning wrapper
Keep byte budget, timeout, original timestamp/position and BUSY preference; do not reuse command/header/response leases prematurely
Ordinary orders use existing routing values to check pending lifecycle; retained lifecycle records preserve existing control behavior
Build fallback trace string only when realtime capture is active on Leader
Pending first reservation membership uses Agrona primitive map retaining backing storage; same-sequence extra memberships and promotion semantics remain
单订单响应在原ResponseArena.Slot租约内复用ByteBuffer写入器；协议保持当前position/limit和原编码字节
state_ownership: 入口Input包装仅由原Aeron回调线程填写，通过原input队列给Owner，Owner在命令被原FIFO接管后清除并归还availableInput；固定8192个，不形成账户或命令镜像
未成功发布的包装仍归回调线程所有；异常前清空字段并保留到下一次尝试，不由生产者写入Owner的归还队列
响应writer属于原ResponseArena.Slot，位置只由实际编码者使用；存储引用计数沿用原transport/ledger租约，未释放时不归还；没有新worker或业务阶段
普通命令直接使用原路由身份判断生命周期范围；需要保留的强平/交割scope仍保持原独立值
预约首成员索引使用原Owner数据，只替换primitive容器实现，不保存资金值；同序号多订单集合和提升语义保留
致命故障复用原accountLaneFailure引用；只有失败路径通知，不创建业务队列或正常路径事件对象

functional_validation.coverage: new input full/interrupt/wrap+protocol writer offset/limit/length reuse+arena delayed release+six product market/limit/mixed batches+native rejection/trigger/funds+retained lifecycle scopes+realtime entity emission; original Error propagation, reporter failure, idle failure detection and joining all Account/Ledger workers

selection.helper_review: selected Cluster trigger rejection helpers recovery=false; realtime emission performs normal events only; CoreSelfTrade all helpers ordinary trade only; admission fact tests use immutable Treasury status facts with no actual snapshots; pipeline Fixture.close does not capture snapshot. Protocol decoder tests are plain wire roundtrips. Fatal path injects a synthetic Error; shutdown joins every Lane and Ledger. No snapshots.

initial_unit_run: unit-first.log共7例通过；最终functional-first.log包含这些用例，不重复计数
protocol_checks: 新ByteBuffer入口与原列表编码字节一致；覆盖非零position、limit、不同符号长度、写入后缀、只读和容量不足；原byte[]入口保留offset语义
not_claimed: 单笔或批量分配小于100B/业务项
Owner全部业务收据、市场/风险控制及输出编码已经迁走
真实Aeron网络、Archive、realtime分配、单节点吞吐或长稳通过
所有旧矩阵测试已经通过
performance_policy: 单笔与20项批量分别在本地记录GC/JFR数值和正式测量窗有效性；不存在本次代码的真实单节点吞吐结论，不提交数值压测记录
subsequent_corrections: 首次采集入口使用旧shaded Jar的protocol，JFR证明新ByteBuffer方法在旧类中缺失，预热抛NoSuchMethodError并留下空JMH行；原失败证据保留，不计性能结论
故障同时暴露空闲完成探测未传播LaneError；已补故障通知、无journal依赖的健康门禁、reporter自身失败保护及Error后的所有worker关闭，回归测试保留原始Error身份与线程退出断言
